source_policy: fixed saved source, piecewise constant on optimization time slabs

resolution.domain: all constrained spatial nodes and all assessment time levels over 0 to 600 seconds
resolution.source_transfer: preserve the frozen spatial field and slabwise source history
resolution.bound_policy: report positive excess with estimated uncertainty; require uncertainty below the resolution gate

forward_policy.fallback: complete-field Anderson from retained Newton fields

rank_selection.recycling: retain existing coarse vectors and new directions; Jacobi-scaled selection
rank_selection.selection_quantity: lowest complete verified time subject to memory and accuracy criteria

final_comparisons.timing: construction, all nonlinear and inner solves, transfers, verification, cleanup
final_comparisons.preparation: report separately and in preparation-inclusive totals

publication_gate: verified model and derivatives, resolved fixed-control assessment, complete matched comparisons, clean-checkout reproduction
optimization_interpretation: verified discrete stationary point; no global optimality claim
